summary.text: Jasmine Rivera, also known as Jaz, is the Republican candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 95 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Democrat Carol Hill-Evans.
She was also the Republican nominee for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Rivera won the Republican primary for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 95 on April 23, 2024, and then lost the November 5, 2024 general election to incumbent Carol Hill-Evans, who received 59.0% of the vote to Rivera's 40.8%.
She advanced from the Republican primary for the same seat on May 19, 2026.
